submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"

finding.headline: "The Cold-Lunch Mama"
finding.problem: "I cooked a real meal and never got to taste it warm. My food is always cold and I'm too tired to reheat it. My body is healing and I'm running on crumbs."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "Feeding the mother while she's feeding the baby"
finding.person: A 30-yr-old Lagos career woman, 6 weeks postpartum, breastfeeding, back at her laptop — she cooks jollof or warms eba, but the baby cluster-feeds and by the time she sits it's stone cold; she eats cold lumps standing up.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product — "Warm-at-Last: 25 Reheat-Proof One-Handed Nigerian Meals."". Verdict: PASSES (19/25)..
